observations: Readable text on cover: “T.D. Jakes” and “WOMAN, THOU ART LOOSED!”
Main title on cover reads: “The LADY, Her LOVER, and Her LORD”.
No other photos show condition details (cover wear, spine, pages, missing parts).

identity.model: The Lady, Her Lover, and Her Lord

claims.claim: “A lady and her Lord is recommended for intentional women who are ready to make impact”
claims.evidence: This is promotional text from the seller; the photo only shows the book title/author, not the seller’s claim about suitability or impact.

risks.risk: Wrong edition/format (hardcover vs paperback) or different printing than the cover shown.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of the back cover and the copyright/ISBN page (or barcode) showing edition/ISBN.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the most common used paperback edition with unknown condition.

risks.risk: Condition issues (missing pages, torn cover, heavy stains, water damage).
risks.proof: Ask for clear photos of: front cover, spine, back cover, and 2–3 inside pages near the beginning and middle.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with possible wear (not guaranteed like-new).

risks.risk: Completeness (book may be missing dust jacket or may be a photocopy/unauthorized print).
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of the ISBN/copyright page and the publisher name page.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a standard used copy with no guarantee of authenticity beyond the cover.

proof_requests: Photo of the back cover and the ISBN/copyright page (barcode/ISBN visible).
Photos of spine and edges (top/bottom) to check wear and completeness.
2–3 inside page photos (beginning, middle) to confirm pages are intact and not water-damaged.
response.reason: I can identify the book title/author from the cover, but there’s no photo evidence of edition/ISBN or condition, which strongly affects the resale price in Abuja. Request ISBN/edition and condition photos first.
